neighbours.label: ' you' and ' your' as the object of affection, thanks or good wishes (love you, appreciate your, thank you, enjoy your)
fire: My aunt says that she loves you very much.
We truly appreciate your patience in this.
Thank you for all your kindness.
I hope you like your new home.
All of us adore you and miss you.
I hope you enjoy your holiday.
Everyone here thanks you for your gift.
quiet: My aunt says that she paid you very little.
We truly need your signature in this box.
We hand you the forms at the door.
I hope you lock your new home.
All of us saw you and left.
I hope you park your car here.
Everyone here told you about the gate.

short: you, your as object of affection or thanks
notes: Second round. The first round ('after a verb') failed: 'blame you' and 'trusts you' stayed under 0.1. In the probes, love, appreciate, thank and enjoy reached 0.48-0.73, and show, bring, blame stayed at or under 0.05. ' saw you' reached 0.26. The declared tokens occur everywhere, so coverage is an upper bound.
